newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: HANSA INVEST CONFIRMS ALYTAUS TEXTILE STAKE.
newsitem.headline: HANSA INVEST CONFIRMS ALYTAUS TEXTILE STAKE.

text.p: Hansa Investments confirmed on Friday that it had been buying up shares in Lithuania's cotton material producer Alytaus Textile and held a 13.58 percent stake in the company.
"Up to the last trade we have 13.58 percent of the company," Nerijus Aidukevichius, associate director of corporate finance for Hansa Investments in Lithuania, told Reuters."
"We have been buying for a month and a half, and I can't state that we will stop buying or keep buying, but we are still buying," Aidukevichius said.
Alytaus Textile, a group B company on the Vilnius stock exchange, has a share capital of 100 million litas, and the state owns over 63 percent of the comany.
"It's most likely that the company will be privatised at the very end of this year or early in 1998," Alytaus Textile Director General, Gintautas Andriushkevichius, told Reuters.
"Along with Hansa Investments there are other potential investors who are interested in the company," Andriushkevichius added.
Alytaus Textile said last month that its sales for the first four months of the year had advanced to 61.1 million litas from 34.9 million litas for the same period last year.
The company posted a 23.02 million litas loss in 1996 on 124.4 million litas turnover.
